# Baselines on the v2 test windows (generated by scripts/run_baselines.py)

Statistical-model settings chosen by validation MAE. MAE in price units (USD/oz global, SDG/g Sudan). DA = directional accuracy vs the previous origin; non-zero = only steps with a non-zero true change; max = ceiling for a forecast that never predicts an exact-zero change. DA-origin non-zero = direction of change from the last observed value, on steps where the price moved (persistence predicts no change, so scores 0).
